# `company.import_sources`

Named origins of import files, one kind each. Never deleted; only active, version and who and when change.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this source. |
| `name` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | — | — | Its name as given ("Square customer export"). |
| `name_key` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | ux_import_sources_name_key | — | The name trimmed, case-folded and with spaces collapsed; unique. |
| `kind` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | The import kind its files hold. |
| `active` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | False once deactivated: its mapping no longer matches files. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Latest mapping version (and optimistic-concurrency version of the source). |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time the source was first saved. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that first saved it. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time of the last new version or deactivation. |
| `updated_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that made that change. |
